create_layernorm_instance: create a LayerNorm module with a specified normalized_shape and default epsilon value

forward_layernorm: run the forward pass of a LayerNorm module on an input Tensor
review_layernorm_forward: review the LayerNorm forward method to understand the normalization computation steps
